observation: The pull-request self-shape job executes repository code. An independent security review found that it inherited default GITHUB_TOKEN permissions and actions/checkout persisted its credential into the workspace. The job now declares contents: read and checkout uses persist-credentials: false.

evidence.reference: PR #28 CodeRabbit review thread PRRT_kwDOTALgUs6XZVxf: zizmor excessive-permissions + artipacked

evidence.summary: The complete self-shape lifecycle passed with GITHUB_TOKEN contents: read and actions/checkout persist-credentials: false. PHP 8.3, 8.4, 8.5 and the installed release-set dogfood were green in the same run.

hypothesis: A pull-request dogfood job that only reads repository contents should declare least-privilege token permissions and should not leave checkout credentials available to the PR-controlled workspace.
validated_conclusion: Keep the pull-request self-shape job at job-level contents: read and configure actions/checkout with persist-credentials: false. The governed lifecycle requires repository history, not a writable or persisted GitHub credential.
